sub3005: The story began with Blackness.
We are slowly waking up from a dream, but can't recall what it's about.
A mirror?
A rabbit?
We were having tea with someone, and it seemed very important,
but the more we try to hold onto the dream it fades.
We finally wake up with a headache and
a bird sitting on our chest chirps.
As we try to pet it it flies away.
After we get up to look around, we are in the woods, surrounded by mushrooms and flowers.
The sun is starting to set, so we decide to rest until morning for sunlight.
As night falls we sleep by a tree.
It's bitterly cold and the wind howls....or was it?
We begin to think we are paranoid.
We get up and run because we don't want to find out.
As we run through the woods we hear snarling behind us,
we keep running until we see a village.
Running to the first door we see,
we knock frantically.
An elderly man opens the door.
We beg him to let us in and explain there are dogs after us.
He lets us in and
we thank him as he stares.
We ask him what's wrong and he denies it at first,
then just says "Simply...well, it's you."
He proceeds to tell us we are royalty
but we don't believe him.
He says our name is Irascile Heart the heir of The Heart Kingdom.
He says we've awoken after many years.
We still don't believe him,
but he says "I know you are" as a matter of fact.
He tells us that he's devoted his life to learning about the royal family
but never imagined meeting one.
He then offers tea, bread, and jam.
As we sit in disbelief we start to remember and faint images start coming back to us.
We remember names like Mary Ann and Phrenesis
but don't know who they belong too.
We stay the night at the old man's house.
Tomorrow we will begin our journey and look for answers about the Heart Kingdom and
to see if we can live up to our title, the Heir.
The End!
sub3013: The story starts with me waking up in darkness from a dream.
I cannot remember the dream properly but remember something about mirrors and feeling like I'm in a rush.
I wake up to find a bird sitting on my chest.
It chirps and
I look around to find that I am in a forest.
It is still night time so I try to go back to sleep.
However, I hear howling near my ears.
I hope it is just the wind
but I do not risk it so I run.
Once I begin running I can hear panting on my heels,
which confirms that the howling was in fact dogs, like I had suspected.
I run until I reach a village and
I knock on the first door I see.
An old man opens the door and
stares at me.
I ask to be let in to get away from the dogs.
He lets me in and
puts a wooden plank over the door.
He still stares at me and
when I ask what's wrong, he explains that I am royalty.
He says he never thought he would meet a royal.
I tell him that it must be a mistake, that I am not a royal
but he tells me that he knows my face.
I begin to remember names from childhood, like Mary Ann and Phenesis.
The old man offers me some tea, and
his bed when I ask if I can stay the night.
I refuse his bed and sleep in the armchair,
needing to get some sleep before I start a big day.
